body.condition: \(g\) belongs to the radius-\(L\) Hölder ball \(C^{s}([0,1]^{d+1})\).

novel.justification: This fixed-radius global \(C^s\) restriction is an instrumental strengthened regular subclass, not a condition attributed to Takatsu and Westling (2025). It is satisfied by randomized or observational dose mechanisms with smoothly varying conditional densities, such as compact-parameter logistic tilts of the uniform dose law.
